summary: Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc., as depositor of Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2025-5C7, filed an 8-K reporting that on August 12, 2026 an Amended and Restated Intercreditor Agreement was executed among UBS AG New York Branch and other noteholders, amending the original intercreditor governing the Crossgates Mall Whole Loan. The loan comprises two notes held by the issuing entity, six pari passu notes and one subordinate note held outside it. No price, stake, premium or closing terms are stated; the filing is a routine CMBS servicing-document amendment, not a special situation.
